descriptions.normal: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts combining Snezhnayan cured meats with Nod-Krai ham and sausage. Many older Nod-Krai locals like to savor it by the fire with a drink in hand.
descriptions.suspicious: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts. The dense fat, bitter and salty, hits the palate like a runaway carriage, leaving a lingering, oily trail down the throat... an intense assault few could endure.
descriptions.delicious: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts. The thick raw cuts carry hints of pine and salt, the sausages give off a deep smoky fragrance, and the ham slices add a rich, savory touch. Bold and hearty, it's a feast any Nod-Krai local would give a thumbs-up to.

effectTexts.normal: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 15% for 300s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s.
effectTexts.delicious: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 20% for 300s.
